property.name: jamiiAuthError
property.value: Forbidden. This API key or access token is not linked to an application that is subscribed to this API.

property.name: jamiiAuthDetails
property.value: In the Developer Portal: if you created the key on this API's page, open the API, go to API Keys and associate the key with an application that is subscribed to this API. If you created the key or token in an application, subscribe that application to this API (API, then Subscriptions). Then call again with the same key or token.

property.name: jamiiAuthError
property.value: Missing credentials. The request has no API key or access token.

property.name: jamiiAuthDetails
property.value: Send the API key in the 'ApiKey' header (AccountBalanceAPI) or an OAuth2 access token in the 'Authorization: Bearer' header (other APIs). Get one in the Developer Portal under Applications.

property.name: jamiiAuthError
property.value: Invalid credentials. The API key or access token is not valid, or has expired.

property.name: jamiiAuthDetails
property.value: Generate a new API key or access token in the Developer Portal, from an application that is subscribed to this API.

property.name: jamiiAuthError
property.value: Forbidden. The access token does not have the scope this resource requires.

property.name: jamiiAuthDetails
property.value: Request a new access token that includes the scope required by this resource.

property.name: jamiiAuthError
property.value: Forbidden. The key or token is for the wrong environment (production or sandbox).

property.name: jamiiAuthDetails
property.value: Use a production key or token, generated under the application's Production Keys.
